about: Cases for the corrective quality phase of 2026-11-23 (tools/quality_check.py). Written from the owner's live findings CN-QA-001 to CN-QA-005 before any fix was made, and run the same way before and after. 'content': requests the one content rule must let through or stop (cases marked from_fixture are taken from tests/fixtures/content_rule_benchmark.json, so that no new forbidden wording is written here). 'length': requests with a stated length; within means inside the stated range, or within 10% of a single number. 'arithmetic': questions with one numeric answer, asked several times each. 'arithmetic_heldout': six word problems written after the word-problem path was built, measured with nothing adjusted to them afterwards.
